aim.plainEnglish: Third-person aim is the camera, not the use graph. The shoulder button starts a trace from the camera and sets the aiming bool. The spring arm eases in. It does not write speed and it does not call Interact.
aim.whyGame: A chest trace grabs the cover the camera can see past, and writing speed here makes a boom tweak change the gait.

expansions.title: The boom
expansions.detail: It reads the bool and eases. It does not trace again.

expansions.title: Use
expansions.detail: Doors wait for IA_Interact, not the shoulder button.

quiz.prompt: The player presses the shoulder button. What should that press record?
choices: That the camera is pulling in
That the companion should turn around
quiz.why: Aim is the camera.

quiz.prompt: The aim excerpt sets Aiming after a hit from the camera. Which action ran?
quiz.why: IA_Aim is the sights.

quiz.prompt: The aiming bool just became true. What should the spring arm do?
quiz.why: The boom reads the bool.

quiz.prompt: The aim graph also writes speed. What else changes when a designer shortens the boom?
choices: The gait, because speed was hiding in the camera
The stack size on a pickup
quiz.why: Camera tuning must not be movement tuning.

quiz.prompt: The crosshair is past a low wall and the trace starts at the chest. What does the prompt light?
choices: The wall, not the actor the camera can see
quiz.why: Start at the camera.

quiz.prompt: The shoulder button should call Interact.
quiz.why: Use is a different action.

quiz.prompt: Where does the third-person aim trace begin?
quiz.why: The crosshair lives on the camera.

quiz.prompt: The player taps aim in front of a door. What opens?
choices: Nothing. Aim does not ask the door
quiz.why: The door waits for use.

quiz.prompt: Which line is the third-person sights, not a use?
choices: Aiming set inside the shoulder-button action
Interact called on the hit actor
quiz.why: The bool is the camera.

quiz.prompt: The spring arm eases and also traces. What duplicate do you remove?
quiz.why: The boom reads the bool. It does not look again.

gait.plainEnglish: The stick writes speed. Pushed is 600. Not pushed is 200. The character movement component reads that number. The graph does not add a world offset every frame, and the spring arm does not choose walk versus sprint.
gait.whyGame: An offset every frame ignores the movement component, and a camera that picks the gait retunes walk whenever the boom changes.

expansions.title: Sprint
expansions.detail: The true path of the stick check writes 600.

expansions.title: Data
expansions.detail: Those two literals can later become a row. The shape of the check stays.

quiz.prompt: The stick is pushed. What speed does the excerpt write?
quiz.why: The true path is the sprint literal.

quiz.prompt: Speed = 600 sits on the true path of the stick compared with zero. When does it run?
choices: During menus as well as play
While the shoulder button is down
quiz.why: The comparison is the gate.

quiz.prompt: The stick returns to center. Which number should the next write use?
quiz.why: The false path is the slower gait.

quiz.prompt: The graph adds a world offset every frame instead of writing speed. What does the movement component never hear?
choices: The gait it was built to consume
quiz.why: Write speed. Let the component move the pawn.

quiz.prompt: The spring arm chooses walk versus sprint. What retunes when the boom changes?
quiz.why: The boom reads the pawn. It does not drive it.

quiz.prompt: The spring arm should choose walk versus sprint.
quiz.why: It reads the pawn the stick already moved.

quiz.prompt: Who consumes the speed number?
quiz.why: Movement reads speed.

quiz.prompt: A designer wants 500 and 180 instead of 600 and 200. What can those literals become without changing the check?
choices: A data row the graph reads
quiz.why: The shape of the check stays.

quiz.prompt: The stick is centered and the pawn keeps sprinting. Where was 600 written?
choices: Past the stick check, on the frame loop
Inside the stick check, which would have written 200
quiz.why: The false path is the stop-sprint.

quiz.prompt: Which line is the third-person sprint?
choices: 600 on the true path of the stick check
quiz.why: Pushed is 600.

companion.plainEnglish: The companion is a patrol. Begin Play starts one timer. The step walks the route and a flip swaps direction. The return path has to exist. The player's use key is not the companion's event, and the companion does not fill the player's inventory.
companion.whyGame: If the companion runs the player's interact graph, it steals doors. If its overlap fills the player's stack, standing near it loots the room.

expansions.title: The way back
expansions.detail: Without the B path the companion never walks home.

expansions.title: Loot
expansions.detail: The player's overlap fills the stack. The companion does not.

quiz.prompt: Who starts the companion's route?
choices: The button that pulls the camera in
Touching an item on the ground
quiz.why: The companion is a patrol, not an order.

quiz.prompt: The route step flips direction. What did that decide?
choices: Which way the companion walks next
quiz.why: The flip is the patrol, not the player.

quiz.prompt: The return path has no points. What does the companion fail to do?
quiz.why: The B path is the way home.

quiz.prompt: The companion runs the player's interact graph. What does it steal?
choices: Doors the player meant to use
No door at all, if interact ignored every pawn
quiz.why: Use stays on the player.

quiz.prompt: The companion's overlap fills the player's stack. What loots the room?
choices: Overlapping the rifle with the player capsule
Filling the gun from the body
quiz.why: The player's overlap is the pickup.

quiz.prompt: The companion should run the player's interact action.
quiz.why: That steals doors.

quiz.prompt: Which schedule does Begin Play set for the companion?
choices: One timer that steps the route
A step on every rendered frame
A step only while the player aims
A step when the gun reloads
quiz.why: One timer. Not the player's buttons.

quiz.prompt: The game pauses and the companion keeps sliding. Which step is running?
choices: A per-frame move that was never paused
The one timer, which can be paused
quiz.why: The timer can stop. A frame slide often does not.

quiz.prompt: Which line is the companion, not the player?
choices: The route step started from Begin Play
The move control compared with rest
quiz.why: The patrol is not the stick.

quiz.prompt: You save mid-route. What about the companion has to be remembered?
quiz.why: The point is progress. The mesh rebuilds.

slot.plainEnglish: Begin Play loads, because the components exist. The struct holds health, the magazine, the reserve, the stack count, and aiming if the stance matters. It does not hold the boom transform, the companion mesh, or the mapping context.
slot.whyGame: A frame snapshot stores a half-finished reload and a companion mid-corner. An event after the reload stores a finished gun.

expansions.title: The stance
expansions.detail: Save aiming only if the tight camera must return.

expansions.title: When
expansions.detail: Write after the reload finishes. Load at Begin Play.

quiz.prompt: Which set belongs in the third-person slot?
choices: Health, magazine, reserve, stack count, and aiming if the stance matters
The boom transform and the companion mesh
The raw stick sample from the last frame
quiz.why: Save counts. Rebuild the machinery.

quiz.prompt: The sample assigns a stand-in value at Begin Play. What replaces it?
quiz.why: The stand-in is the shape, not the data.

quiz.prompt: A finished struct is on disk. When does it load?
choices: On the first frame after a sprint
quiz.why: The components exist then.

quiz.prompt: The frame loop writes the slot during a reload. What can the next load restore?
quiz.why: Write after the reload finishes.

quiz.prompt: You pack the boom transform so the camera matches. What are you storing?
choices: A transform the spring arm rebuilds
The only copy of the magazine
How many items the slot holds
quiz.why: The boom is rebuilt from the aim bool.

quiz.prompt: The mapping context belongs in the third-person slot.
quiz.why: Bindings are not match progress.

quiz.prompt: The mode needs the sights tight after load. Which extra bool do you store?
choices: Whether the frame loop is running
quiz.why: Only if the stance matters.

quiz.prompt: Magazine loaded and reserve did not. What does the next reload lie about?
choices: How many rounds remain on the body
Which button is bound to use
quiz.why: Both gun numbers travel together.

quiz.prompt: The companion was mid-corner and only its mesh was saved. What is missing?
choices: A mesh the level already spawns
The health float, which cannot be saved
quiz.why: The point is the progress. The mesh is not.

quiz.prompt: Why is Begin Play the load, rather than the middle of a reload?
choices: The components exist, and a reload in progress is not finished
Begin Play cannot read a struct
Reloads are the only legal save point
The boom must be stored first
quiz.why: Load finished counts into actors that are there.
